data.gender_notes: Aqifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aqifa is an Arabic name for a girl that means 'easy to remember'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'aqafa', which means 'to remember' or 'to be remembered'. This name is often given to a child whose parents want them to be easily recognizable and memorable. The name Aqifa carries the meaning “Easy to remember” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aqifa usually hope their child will grow to embody easy to remember and live with faith, good character and purpose.
